title: Ayume Core
description: Public API mod for Ayume projects
body:
![AyumeCore Banner For Modrinth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/214ea3bb02fc3573139b3d46a12089d09b8499e8_0.webp) # ☕ Ayume Core > Hello, cadet! >
This mod is created for Ayume mods being working. >
Ayume is SMP Minecraft server, where License players can play with incredeble mods. ### Chat formatting > Ayume Core support chat format for server & client chat. Use global chat by typing "!" before your message and "(none)" for local chat! > ![Chat formatting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8bda06b1d5bbb98f920e990d52495350b4f342f8.png) > Also for your sponsord - heart suffix :3 > ![Suffix for chat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/424e9a844256205ec47e33004a712bdfdbe165d0.png) --- ### Our Discord community (Russian only :<) [![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ac8884b3c4916cbac2b514220b9bb678db039b7.png)](https://discord.gg/wKwP7ASCR8)
